name: Microsoft Teams
description_en:
Microsoft Teams combines workplace chat, channels, meetings and application access around Microsoft 365 identities and services. Files and recordings have their own storage and sharing rules; appearing in a Teams conversation does not make every participant an authorized reader.

This profile follows a proposed supplier review: choose a collaboration identity, place a document in the right channel, meet, record where permitted and preserve the resulting material. Teams Free, standalone Essentials, Microsoft 365 plans with or without Teams, and Phone, Rooms, Premium or Copilot entitlements should be evaluated separately.
description_zh:
Microsoft Teams 围绕 Microsoft 365 身份及服务结合工作聊天、频道、会议与应用访问。文件和录制各有存储及共享规则，出现在 Teams 对话中，并不代表每个参与者都有阅读资格。

本稿沿假设的供应商审阅流程展开：选择协作身份，把文档放入合适频道，开会，在允许时录制，并保留产出。Teams Free、独立 Essentials、包含或不含 Teams 的 Microsoft 365 套餐，以及 Phone、Rooms、Premium、Copilot 资格应分别评估。

sections.title_en: Begin with identity and the work account
sections.title_zh: 从身份及工作账户开始
sections.en:
A proposed supplier review may involve a short external conversation, ongoing guest membership or a shared channel between organizations. Decide which relationship is needed before sending a document. Essentials currently uses Microsoft Entra identity, with licenses assigned through the Microsoft admin center; purchasing seats and installing a client do not themselves configure partner access.

The work product spans desktop, web and mobile, but feature support differs by cloud and license. It is most useful when the organization can operate the connected Microsoft 365 identity and storage services. Teams does not make every Microsoft product or partner app part of the same entitlement, and a personal/free account should not be assumed to behave like an administered work account.
sections.zh:
假设进行供应商审阅，可能只需短暂外部对话，也可能需要持续访客成员资格，或组织间共享频道。发送文档前先确定所需关系。Essentials 当前使用 Microsoft Entra 身份，通过 Microsoft 管理中心分配许可证；购买席位及安装客户端，本身不会配置合作方访问。

工作产品覆盖桌面、网页及移动端，但功能随云环境及许可而异。组织具备运营关联 Microsoft 365 身份及存储服务的能力时，它更适用。Teams 不会把所有 Microsoft 产品或合作方应用都纳入同一资格，也不能假定个人／免费账户与受管工作账户行为相同。

sections.title_en: Guests and shared-channel participants are different identities
sections.title_zh: 访客与共享频道参与者具有不同身份
sections.en:
Guest access adds an outside person to the organization’s team experience through Entra B2B collaboration. The owner adds the guest, the guest accepts and authenticates, and access can take up to 12 hours. An immediate failure after invitation need not justify a broader sharing policy.

A shared channel uses a different route: guests cannot be added, and sharing it with a team does not bring that team’s guests along. An external participant needs a Microsoft 365 work/school Teams account, with B2B direct connect configured by administrators in both organizations. Choose the route the partner can actually support; a consumer mailbox invitation is not interchangeable with cross-tenant channel trust. No guest or trust configuration was changed.
sections.zh:
访客访问通过 Entra B2B collaboration 把外部人员加入组织的团队体验。负责人添加访客，访客接受并验证身份，访问最多可能需12小时。邀请后立即失败，不一定需要扩大共享策略。

共享频道采用另一条路径：不能添加访客，把频道共享给团队也不会连带纳入该团队的访客。外部参与者需有 Microsoft365 工作／学校 Teams 账户，并由双方组织管理员配置 B2B direct connect。应选择合作方实际支持的方式；向个人邮箱发邀请不能替代跨租户频道信任。本研究未更改访客或信任配置。

sections.title_en: External chat file sharing now has a specific policy path
sections.title_zh: 外部聊天文件共享已有专项策略路径
sections.en:
The general external-access comparison still lists file sharing as unavailable, while the dedicated feature guide documents it when an administrator enables external-chat attachments. Treat this as a documentation mismatch rather than a permanent prohibition or universal availability. The sender’s OneDrive/SharePoint policies still govern access; enabling Teams sharing does not override labels or domain restrictions.

The guide labels automatic permission assignment and guest sharing from the home tenant as public preview. Uploading or attaching under automatic sharing can grant the chat audience access, whereas pasting an existing link preserves its current sharing scope. Teams Free senders in mixed Work chats have different limits. For the supplier example, inspect the actual file permissions and recipient’s browser access rather than treating a visible attachment as proof of access.
sections.zh:
一般外部访问对比表仍把文件共享列为不可用，专项指南则规定管理员启用外部聊天附件后可共享。应视为文档不一致，不能写成永久禁止或普遍可用。发送者的 OneDrive／SharePoint 策略仍控制访问，启用 Teams 共享不会覆盖标签或域名限制。

指南把自动分配权限、访客从原租户共享列为公开预览。在自动共享下上传或附加文件可能给聊天参与者授权，粘贴既有链接则保留原共享范围。混合 Work 聊天中 Teams Free 发送者的限制也不同。在供应商示例中，应检查真实文件权限及接收者浏览器访问，不能把可见附件当作有权访问的证明。

sections.title_en: Choose the file’s home before sharing it
sections.title_zh: 共享前先选择文件归属
sections.en:
Chat uploads live in the sender’s OneDrive for Business. Standard-channel files use folders in the team’s parent SharePoint site, while private and shared channels have separate channel sites. A proposed long-running review document therefore needs a deliberate home instead of remaining dependent on a casual chat upload.

Channel-site membership is controlled through the channel, but file/link sharing is another layer. The integration guide permits separate file/folder links in specified cases, so private channel membership alone should not be described as the complete file boundary. Shared-channel external sharing is constrained to external participants in that channel. Check both membership and existing file links when removing a collaborator. Full migration of links, permissions, versions and associated app data was not tested.
sections.zh:
聊天上传文件位于发送者的 OneDrive for Business；标准频道文件使用团队主 SharePoint 站点内的文件夹，私有及共享频道则各有独立频道站点。因此长期审阅文档应有明确归属，不宜只依赖临时聊天上传。

频道站点成员通过频道控制，但文件／链接共享是另一层。集成指南在特定情形允许独立文件／文件夹链接，不能把私有频道成员资格写成完整文件边界。共享频道的外部共享限该频道的外部参与者。移除协作者时，应同时检查成员资格及既有文件链接。本研究未测试链接、权限、版本及相关应用数据的完整迁移。

sections.title_zh: 录制只保留选定会议内容
sections.en:
Recording needs suitable licenses and enabled policies; guests and outside-organization attendees cannot start meeting recording in the user guide. Participants receive a notification, while any required permission remains a separate responsibility. The guide excludes whiteboards, annotations, shared notes and certain app/PowerPoint Live content from recordings, so a recording is not a complete project artifact.

Admin settings determine expiration and editors can adjust it. The owner’s stated recovery window after expiration is up to 90 days in the recycle bin; watching the video does not extend expiry. External attendees need explicit sharing. For the supplier review, preserve the document and agreed actions separately, then verify the actual recording link and deadline. Eligibility depends on current SKU and meeting policy; no meeting, consent flow or recovery was tested.
sections.zh:
用户指南要求适当许可及已启用策略，访客和组织外参会者不能开始会议录制。参与者会收到通知，任何所需同意仍是独立责任。指南把白板、批注、共享笔记及部分应用／PowerPoint Live 内容排除在录制外，因此录制不是完整项目产物。

管理员设置决定到期时间，编辑者可调整。指南给出的到期后回收站恢复窗口最多90天，观看不会延长到期日。外部参会者需要明确共享。供应商审阅应另存文档及商定行动，再检查实际录制链接和期限。资格依赖当前 SKU 及会议策略；本研究未测试会议、同意流程或恢复。

sections.title_en: A recording failure can require action within 21 days
sections.title_zh: 录制失败可能需要21天内处理
sections.en:
The admin storage guide places ordinary meeting/event recordings in the organizer’s OneDrive, channel recordings in SharePoint, and one-to-one/group-call recordings in the recording initiator’s OneDrive. Without an organizer’s usable OneDrive, co-organizer and initiator fallbacks apply.

If the upload fails because relevant accounts lack storage or quota is full, temporary async storage is used and no automatic upload retry occurs. The organizer must download within 21 days or the recording is deleted; gaining storage does not justify assuming the retry has happened. Check destination, quota and file readability promptly. Storage for recordings counts against the underlying service quota, and ownership after staff departure follows its processes. These documented fallbacks were not executed.
sections.zh:
管理员存储指南把普通会议／活动录制放在组织者 OneDrive，频道会议放在 SharePoint，一对一／群组通话则放在启动录制者的 OneDrive。组织者没有可用 OneDrive 时，会按共同组织者及启动录制者回退。

如果相关账户无存储或配额已满而上传失败，会使用临时异步存储，不会自动重试上传。组织者须在21天内下载，否则录制被删除；取得存储后也不能假定已完成重试。应及时检查目标、配额及文件可读性。录制占用底层服务配额，员工离职后的归属按相应服务流程处理。本研究未执行这些回退。

sections.title_en: Price the licensed workflow, not just the meeting link
sections.title_zh: 按获许可的流程估算费用
sections.en:
The inspected US business page displays Teams Essentials at $4/user/month paid yearly with automatic renewal, 10GB storage per user and up to 300 participants for 30-hour meetings. That is a subscription commitment, not a $4 one-month purchase. Microsoft 365 offers may explicitly include or exclude Teams; advanced AI usage and Phone/Rooms/Premium conditions require separate checks.

The page’s trial footnote requires a card and converts after one month unless canceled. It describes a seven-day prorated cancellation window after paid service begins; applicable procurement terms still need confirmation. Under the inspected MCA Teams terms, external meeting attendees and qualifying Entra guests have specified license exceptions. Do not price every invited attendee as an employee seat, or assume the exception covers every external collaboration feature. No price quote, checkout or cancellation was executed.
sections.zh:
所读美国企业定价页显示 Teams Essentials 每用户每月 $4、按年付、自动续订，每用户10GB，会议最多300人、30小时。这是订阅承诺，不是花 $4 购买单月。Microsoft365 方案可能明确包含或排除 Teams，高级 AI 用量及 Phone／Rooms／Premium 条件需另查。

页面试用脚注要求银行卡，一个月后未取消会转付费，并描述付费开始后七天内按比例退款的取消窗口；实际采购条款仍需确认。所读 MCA Teams 条款对外部参会者和符合条件的 Entra 访客有特定许可豁免，不能把每名受邀者都计为员工席位，也不能假定豁免涵盖所有外部协作功能。本研究未报价、结账或取消。

sections.title_en: Plan exit across messages, files and recording storage
sections.title_zh: 退出规划需覆盖消息、文件及录制存储
sections.en:
The general Microsoft 365 assurance page describes a 90-day limited-function extraction period after a paid subscription ends and maximum deletion timing up to 180 days. Those statements do not promise that every Teams purchase route, user view or app can reconstruct a complete workspace. Active deletion, recording expiration and subscription termination are distinct cases.

Before adoption, define the required exit copy across messages, channel/OneDrive documents, recordings, app data and access settings. A file download alone does not demonstrate a restorable tenant. Actual export completeness, retention holds, staff offboarding, regional residency and contract-specific cancellation remain unverified here. Export before losing usable access and confirm the applicable agreement rather than treating the deletion maximum as a recovery allowance.
sections.zh:
一般 Microsoft365 保障页描述付费订阅结束后90天有限功能取回期，以及最长180天删除时序；这不承诺每种 Teams 采购渠道、用户视图或应用都能重建完整工作区。主动删除、录制到期及订阅终止是不同情形。

采用前应定义消息、频道／OneDrive 文档、录制、应用数据及访问设置所需的退出副本。下载文件本身不证明租户可恢复。实际导出完整性、保留冻结、员工离职、地区驻留及合同专属取消在此仍未核实。应在失去可用访问前导出并确认适用协议，而非把最长删除时限当作恢复额度。

sections.title_en: The managed service has commercial use rights
sections.title_zh: 托管服务采用商业使用权
sections.en:
The inspected MCA online-service terms require appropriate assigned subscription licenses except service-specific exceptions, reserve other rights and end service-use rights when the subscription ends. This supports classifying the Teams service as proprietary; open SDK examples or an API do not provide a self-hostable Teams server license. The applicable DPA, purchase agreement and non-Microsoft app terms remain separate.

An organization already administering Microsoft 365 may find the connected identity/file model useful. A team wanting a self-contained, independently hosted workspace must verify that requirement elsewhere. This is an editorial selection boundary, not an operational security assessment. No account, team, policy, app permission, file share, recording or payment was changed.
sections.zh:
所读 MCA 在线服务条款要求适当分配订阅许可证，服务专属例外除外，保留其他权利，并在订阅结束后终止使用权。因此可把 Teams 服务归为专有服务，开放 SDK 示例或 API 不提供可自托管 Teams 服务器的许可。适用 DPA、采购协议及非 Microsoft 应用条款仍然独立。

已管理 Microsoft365 的组织可能受益于关联身份／文件模型；希望独立托管、自成一体工作区的团队须另行核实该需求。这是编辑选型边界，不是运行安全评估。本研究未更改账户、团队、策略、应用权限、文件共享、录制或付款。

seo.title_en: Microsoft Teams: External Access, Channel Files, Recording and Plan Scope
seo.title_zh: Microsoft Teams：外部访问、频道文件、录制及套餐范围
seo.description_en: Follow a supplier review through guest and shared-channel identities, external file policies, OneDrive/SharePoint storage and recording failure recovery.
seo.description_zh: 沿供应商审阅核对访客及共享频道身份、外部文件策略、OneDrive／SharePoint 存储及录制失败处理。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Teams work collaboration across partner access, artifacts and subscriptions.
secondary_questions: Can external Teams chats share files under current policy?
Where do failed meeting recordings go?
seo.query_basis: Editorial questions; no measured demand or ranking.

research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、团队／频道、访客邀请、信任／策略编辑、文件、会议／录制、应用、导出／恢复、购买或取消。

research_gaps.en: General external-file comparison conflicts with dedicated sharing article; preview availability and actual tenant behavior unknown. Exact currentSKU recording support/permissions need account verification; current Essentials pricing lists recordings while userguide license examples use broader/older names.
research_gaps.zh: 一般外部文件对比表与专项共享文章冲突，预览可用性和实际租户行为未知。当前 SKU 精确录制支持／权限需账户核实，现行 Essentials 定价列录制，用户指南许可示例使用较广／旧名称。

research_gaps.en: Complete tenant/third-partyapp export and restore, region/service guarantees, AI processing/providers/retention, Free commercial parity and contract-specific offboarding/cancellation/data deletion remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 完整租户／第三方应用导出恢复、地区／服务保证、AI 处理／供应商／保留、Free 商业使用一致性及合同专属离职／取消／删除未核实。
